title: Rebirth in the Dark Night
next_chapter_hook: Just as undercurrents surged within the imperial capital, Su Qingyao unexpectedly obtained a mysterious item at the Crown Prince's birthday banquet—a Jade Pendant inscribed with Chen Ji's birth date and eight characters, its origin pointing to someone who should have been dead.

text.content:
The laughter of the Eye of Heavenly Dao echoed through the depths of the Void, that ancient and casual scoff seeming to mock the self-importance of the world's ants. Yet on the other end of this laughter, a body that should have been cold quietly opened its eyes.

Chen Ji felt the penetrating wound in his chest healing at an incredible speed, the burning sensation of Heavenly Fate Value loss ebbing away like a tide. He slowly sat up, his gaze sweeping across his surroundings—this was a simple basement, the air filled with the mingled scent of herbs and blood.

dialogue.content:
"You really are hard to kill."

Mo Xiansheng's voice came from his chest, carrying a hint of mockery. Chen Ji looked down and found the Tianji Record Fragment pressed against his chest, with faint characters appearing on the paper: Heavenly Fate Value -35, remaining 182.

text.content:
"Thirty-five points of Heavenly Fate Value, in exchange for one life, not a bad deal."

Chen Ji stood up and walked to the bronze mirror. The person in the mirror had delicate features, but his gaze was deep as an abyss, nothing like the pathetic wretch who had been spineless before others. He reached out, fingers tracing lightly on his face, and a mask as thin as a cicada's wing covered it, transforming into an extremely ordinary face.

dialogue.content:
"From this day forward, there is no longer any such person as Chen Ji in this world."

His voice was calm as still water, yet at the end carried a hint of chilling intent. Only the "Dragon Vein Awakener" would rise quietly in the shadows of the imperial capital.

text.content: At the same time, chaos was erupting throughout the Tianqing Sect. The Crown Prince faction's scouts had relayed the news of "Chen Ji's death" back to the capital, and the imperial court instantly churned with undercurrents. The life or death of thattrash杂役 was not worth mentioning, yet the forces entangled behind him made everyone smell blood.

dialogue.content:
Deep within a dark underground palace in the imperial capital, a young woman bound in chains suddenly opened her eyes. Disheveled and covered in grime, surrounded by诡异的金色纹路, she was Chen Nian, imprisoned by the Holy Sect for years as a "Heavenly Fate Lock Key."

She sensed something—a tremor from deep within her bloodline.

text.content: And in the Tianqing Sect Inner Sect, Su Qingyao was surrounded by a group of Inner Disciples loyal to the Crown Prince. Their leader was Han Lie's confidant, currently reading something aloud with an得意洋洋 expression.

dialogue.content:
"Senior Su, Chen Ji is already dead. Are you still going to keep his secrets for him?"

The man smiled with a sinister air, yet concealed serpentine malice in his eyes. "The Crown Prince values your talent. If you would simply submit, past matters could be forgiven. Otherwise..."

Su Qingyao laughed coldly, her sword unsheathing three inches, its cold light threatening.

She remembered the last glance Chen Ji had given her before his "death"—that gaze held no fear, only a composure that chilled her, as if everything was under his control.

"Otherwise what?"

Su Qingyao's voice was cold enough to freeze, as she surveyed her surroundings and silently memorized each face. "Dare to bully me? You really think I'm made of mud?"

choice.prompt: The dark side of the imperial capital was stirring, all factions searching for the key piece that could stir the winds of change. With your identity as the "Dragon Vein Awakener" revealed, which side will you choose to support?

choices.description: The Crown Prince faction has deep roots, but due to Chen Ji's death, they have begun purging old members, creating widespread panic. Now is the time to act—securing maximum resources while slowly poisoning them like frogs in warming water.
choices.visible_cost: Requires spending 50 Reputation to approach the Crown Prince's inner circle
choices.visible_reward: Gain the status of a Crown Prince's retainer, entering the core of imperial power
choices.risk_hint: The Crown Prince is highly suspicious; once exposed, you become a target for all

text.content:
Chen Ji donned black robes, appearing silently at the Crown Prince's back door as the "Dragon Vein Awakener." He didn't rush to reveal himself, instead observing the Crown Prince's guards through the night—the old fox had indeed purged his old associates immediately after Chen Ji's "death," his methods crudely blatant.

A cold smile curled at his lips: "Your Highness, the more desperate you become, the more holes appear in your defenses."

choices.description: The Princess's faction seized the opportunity to rise, rivaling the Crown Prince. Though her foundation is shallow, her ambition burns—she desperately needs a pivotal figure to shift the balance. This is the perfect moment for high returns on minimal investment.
choices.visible_cost: Requires spending 30 Heavenly Fate Value to demonstrate prophetic ability
choices.visible_reward: Become the Princess's honored guest, gaining access to the imperial capital's most clandestine intelligence network
choices.risk_hint: The Princess is deeply calculating; she may turn the tables and use you instead

text.content:
Three days later, the Princess hosted a flower-viewing banquet. A mysterious man materialized before the assembled guests, stating simply: "Your Highness will receive a grand gift tomorrow, and then you'll know I speak no falsehood."

The next day, the Crown Prince's confidant suddenly impeached one of his own at court—the exact scene Chen Ji had witnessed through the Tianji Record the night before. Shocked, the Princess immediately summoned the mysterious man to a private chamber.

choices.description: Let them fight until both sides are exhausted, so you can reap the benefits like the fisherman. Secretly support a few key figures, letting them check each other, while you sit steadily at the fishing platform.
choices.visible_cost: Requires consuming 40 Strategy Points for long-term arrangement
choices.visible_reward: Both sides will view you as a potential ally, with resources and information flooding in
choices.risk_hint: High time cost, may miss the window for rapid rise

text.content:
Chen Ji concealed himself in the hidden alleys of the imperial capital, sending thought-provoking invitations to both the Crown Prince faction and the Princess faction under the name of 'Dragon Vein Awakener'. The content contained only four words: Wait for the Moment.

Both sides were bewildered, yet they sensed an invisible hand manipulating the chess game behind the scenes. They unanimously chose to observe—and this was precisely the result Chen Ji desired.

Over the next seven days, the imperial capital seemed thrown into a cauldron of boiling water. The Crown Prince ruthlessly purged Chen Ji's 'former subordinates', but his brutal methods sparked widespread resentment; the Princess seized the opportunity to recruit officials dissatisfied with the Crown Prince, and the confrontation between the two factions intensified.

The mysterious 'Dragon Vein Awakener' drifted like a specter between the two factions. He accepted the Crown Prince's banquet invitations and attended the Princess's tea parties, his words and actions flawless, yet always managing to say something that sent chills down both sides at crucial moments.

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji sat in an elegant tea house room, gazing through half-rolled bamboo blinds at the endless flow of people on the street below. He was waiting—for an opportunity, one that would allow him to 'reunite' with Su Qingyao.

The image of her being surrounded flashed through his mind, and his fingers gently tapped the table, a barely perceptible killing intent flickering in his eyes.

choice.prompt: All factions are searching for the true identity of the 'Dragon Vein Awakener'. How will you make them more convinced that you are an ally worth cultivating?

choices.description: Reveal an imminent assassination at the Crown Prince's birthday banquet in advance, letting him witness your true value. The cost is consuming 30 Heavenly Fate, but this can completely impress the Crown Prince's inner circle.
choices.visible_reward: Crown Prince Favorability +20, obtain the highest-level Guest Advisor token from the Crown Prince's residence
choices.risk_hint: Displaying abilities may attract the attention of the Heavenly Dao's Eye

text.content:
On the day of the Crown Prince's birthday banquet, guests gathered like clouds. As everyone was raising their cups in celebration, Chen Ji rose slowly, setting down his teacup gently.

'Your Highness, in three breaths, a killer will fall from the western beam—and the target is you.'

Before the words finished, a black figure indeed tumbled from the beam and was immediately captured by the Crown Prince's personal guards. The entire hall erupted in chaos, and the Crown Prince's gaze toward Chen Ji instantly changed.

choices.description: The more mysterious you are, the more it inspires fear. Continue to be aloof yet approachable, letting them speculate about your background and strength—shifting between reality and illusion, impossible to distinguish truth from falsehood.
choices.visible_reward: Both factions intensify their recruitment efforts, competing to offer better terms
choices.risk_hint: May be viewed as an untrustworthy opportunist lacking sincerity

text.content:
Faced with the competing recruitment efforts of the Crown Prince and Princess, Chen Ji always maintained the perfect distance. He was sometimes cold, sometimes warm, leaving both sides unable to decipher his true intentions.

'This person is unfathomable.'—this was the unanimous assessment of him across both intelligence networks. And this was precisely the effect Chen Ji desired.
However, just as undercurrents swirled through the imperial capital, news quietly reached Chen Ji—Su Qingyao had unexpectedly acquired a mysterious item at the Crown Prince's birthday banquet.

It was a jade pendant as warm and smooth as water, clearly engraved with Chen Ji's birth date and time. When the Crown Prince's trusted aide presented this item, the entire birthday banquet fell silent.

'This is... that waste's keepsake?' The Crown Prince narrowed his eyes. 'How did it end up in Su Qingyao's hands?'

dialogue.content:
Su Qingyao's expression remained composed, but her heart churned with monstrous waves. She clearly remembered that this jade pendant had been handed to her by Chen Ji himself, a day before his 'death'. At that time, he said:

'If the day comes when I'm no longer here, keep it for me.'

She had always thought it was merely a joke... until now...

text.content: At the same time, in a dark alley somewhere in the imperial capital, Chen Ji received a message from Mo Xiansheng. "Is the Jade Pendant something you deliberately let out?" Mo Xiansheng's voice carried a hint of playfulness, "Are you trying to make Su's girl suffer public humiliation, or... do you have other schemes?"

dialogue.content: Chen Ji did not answer. His gaze pierced through the layers of rooftops, as if he could see that stubborn figure at the birthday banquet. Su Qingyao, didn't you always want to know the truth? He recited silently in his heart, a meaningful curve appearing at the corner of his mouth. The truth will present itself to you when you need it most.

choice.prompt: Su Qingyao was pushed into the eye of the storm due to that Jade Pendant. The Crown Prince suspected their old feelings hadn't ended. How should you deal with this unexpected situation?

choices.description: Step forward publicly at the birthday banquet under the identity of "Dragon Vein Awakener", use your Foresight Ability to help her out, proving she has no connection to "Chen Ji's death". The cost is exposing some of your strength, and your connection with her might be discovered.
choices.visible_cost: Expose potential connection with Su Qingyao
choices.visible_reward: Su Qingyao Affection +30, unlock follow-up deep interactions
choices.risk_hint: Might arouse the Crown Prince's suspicion, leading to investigation of your true identity

text.content: Chen Ji stood up, straightened his robe, and strode toward the main hall of the birthday banquet. "Wait." His voice wasn't loud, yet it instantly drew all eyes, "I can explain this Jade Pendant." The Crown Prince narrowed his eyes: "Oh? Does the Dragon Vein Awakener have involvement in this matter?" "Of course." Chen Ji smiled faintly, "Because—this Jade Pendant was originally entrusted to me by Chen Ji for delivery."

choices.description: Trust Su Qingyao to handle it herself. First observe what choices she makes under pressure. This is both a test and an opportunity to observe her true heart.
choices.visible_reward: More comprehensively understand Su Qingyao's adaptability, consolidate foundation for future cooperation
choices.risk_hint: If she handles it improperly, might lose an important ally

text.content: Chen Ji retreated into the shadows of the crowd, watching the situation develop quietly. Su Qingyao was worthy of being an Inner Disciple Senior Fellow. Faced with the咄咄逼人 of the Crown Prince faction, she didn't panic at all. Instead, she laughed coldly: "It's just a Jade Pendant. Why is everyone making such a fuss? Chen Ji was merely a Menial Servant in his lifetime. Why shouldn't I keep his belongings?" Her momentum actually suppressed the other side.

choices.memory_label: 暗中观察苏青瑶的应变能力

choices.description: Create new variables in the shadows, shifting the Crown Prince faction's attention away from Su Qingyao. For example, release another more explosive piece of news, redirecting the fire elsewhere.
choices.visible_reward: Su Qingyao safely escapes, while striking a blow to the Crown Prince faction's prestige

text.content: Just as the atmosphere reached a boiling point, a spy from the Crown Prince's residence rushed in, whispering a few words into the Crown Prince's ear. The Crown Prince's expression instantly turned extremely ugly. "This matter will be discussed later!" He rose abruptly, leaving the hall full of bewildered guests exchanging glances. Chen Ji nodded with satisfaction in the shadows—the news he'd had spread about "the Princess faction secretly contacting the Xuanwu Sect" had apparently taken effect.

The birthday banquet ended on an unhappy note, but the undercurrents of the imperial capital will only grow more turbulent. The struggle between the Crown Prince and Princess has officially surfaced, and the mysterious "Dragon Vein Awakener" has become a key piece that both sides want to recruit.

Late at night, Chen Ji sat alone on a high tower where he was temporarily staying, the Tianji Record Fragment spread open on his knees. He stared at the faintly visible star in the heavens—the direction of the Eye of Heavenly Dao. Mo Xiansheng was right, this was only the beginning.

dialogue.content: Little one, don't think you can heave a sigh of relief just because you've been reborn. Mo Xiansheng's voice carried a warning: the Eye of Heavenly Dao has already noticed you. From now on, you must tread carefully with every step you take.

Chen Ji smiled lightly and tucked the Tianji Record into his chest. I've never thought about heaving a sigh of relief. He stood up, overlooking the illuminated imperial capital below, silently calculating his next move in his heart. The Crown Prince, the Princess, Su Qingyao, Chen Nian... all the pieces are in position. Now, it's just a matter of waiting for them to make their moves.

text.content:
Just as he turned to leave, the Tianji Record suddenly grew slightly warm. A clear line of text appeared on its surface—

"Heavenly fate stirs, the Lock Key appears."

Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. Chen Nian—she finally made her move.
